# Format (TAB-separated):  pieza <TAB> ruta <TAB> governance <TAB> clase <TAB> que_es

#     engine   the engine governs it · universal · travels identical to every clone

#     shared   the engine defines the FORM, the owner fills the CONTENT
#   clase — HOW the piece is born:
#     canonical  written by hand · the source of truth
#     fossil     historical · kept for reference · not live
# ⛔ governance answers a DIFFERENT question than clase. Do not merge them.
# ⛔ No instance data in any row: no owner name, no real repo/project name in que_es.
#    A person's name was never a governance value — it was a leak. The value is
#    the ROLE ("owner"), never who currently holds it.
# ⭐ HOW TO TELL engine FROM owner — the test that settles it:
#    ask "would a different installation edit this file?"  No  → engine.
#    A file the owner READS but never rewrites is engine (base-rules.md, the
#    four architects): doctrine ships identical, and mislabelling it as owner
#    would hide it from any check that verifies engine files carry no instance
